description: Default-state witness for agent-traversed flows: seals the flow's default-state vector element by element at traversal start (checkboxes, toggles, radio/plan selectors, continuity switches) from the executing surface only, diffs it against the principal's own confirmation/charge artifacts, and mints a verdict (PRESELECTED-AND-CHARGED / PRESELECTED-NOT-CHARGED / NO-PRESELECTION / UNVERIFIABLE) under a published element grammar, recomputable by any holder of the sealed record. Buyer-side capture only; no form-field values are ever held; the check is free.
name: ai.cetech/eclipse-darkseal

environmentVariables.description: Path to the record state JSON document.
environmentVariables.name: ECLIPSE_DARKSEAL_STATE

environmentVariables.description: Path to the executing-surface channel keys JSON (surface-held in production).
environmentVariables.name: ECLIPSE_DARKSEAL_SURFACE_KEYS

title: Cyan Eclipse Darkseal
